mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title AS project_title, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member m WHERE m.project_id = p.id AND m.deleted = 0) AS member_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS submission_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.task_id, s.user_id) AS submitted_pair_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS reviewed_count, ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) AS avg_score FROM training_project p LEFT JOIN task t ON t.project_id = p.id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN task_submission s ON s.task_id = t.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN task_review r ON r.submission_id = s.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.id, p.title ORDER BY p.id
